title: Scope: essential and important entities
summary: Check whether you are an essential or important entity based on sector (Annexes I and II), size and national designation.

title: Governance and management accountability
summary: Management bodies approve cybersecurity risk-management measures, oversee them, can be held liable, and must follow training.

title: Risk-management measures
summary: Take appropriate and proportionate technical, operational and organizational measures, using an all-hazards approach.

title: Risk analysis and information system security policies
summary: Policies on risk analysis and information system security.

title: Incident handling
summary: Processes to prevent, detect and respond to incidents.

title: Business continuity and crisis management
summary: Backup management, disaster recovery and crisis management.

title: Supply chain security
summary: Security of relationships with direct suppliers and service providers.

title: Secure acquisition, development and maintenance
summary: Security in network and information systems acquisition, development and maintenance, including vulnerability handling and disclosure.

title: Effectiveness assessment
summary: Policies and procedures to assess the effectiveness of risk-management measures.

title: Cyber hygiene and training
summary: Basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training.

title: Cryptography
summary: Policies on cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption.

title: HR security, access control and asset management
summary: Human resources security, access control policies and asset management.

title: Multi-factor authentication and secure communications
summary: Use MFA or continuous authentication and secured voice, video, text and emergency communications where appropriate.

title: Incident reporting
summary: Report significant incidents to the CSIRT or authority: early warning within 24 hours, notification within 72 hours, final report within one month.

title: Informing service recipients
summary: Inform recipients of significant incidents likely to affect their services without undue delay, where appropriate.

title: Registration with the authority
summary: Provide required information to the competent authority (for some digital entities, to the registry in the main establishment country).

title: Supervision
summary: Cooperate with supervision: inspections, audits, information requests.
